zh.title: 应用图标量板 · DSH 设计资源
zh.legend: 容器（灰框）· 文件画布 36×36（虚线）· 墨迹与外接圆（现测）
zh.block1Title: 1 · 插件列表里的一行（实测几何）
zh.block1Lead: 行 976 × 66 · 圆角 20 · padding 8 · 行内 gap 14 · 图标容器 50 × 50 圆角 16（1px 描边）· 图标本体 36 × 36
zh.harmonizerDesc: 对齐左栏与内容列的宽度，把各设置页的表头统一成官方一套
zh.widgetsDesc: 会话内的自定义小组件
zh.block2Title: 2 · 外接圆与内间距（放大 4 倍，数字现测）
zh.block2Lead1: 两个图标文件都声明 36 × 36，但图形本身只占了画布的一部分——「墨迹」由浏览器按真实路径的
zh.block2Lead2: 算出（行几何与 7px 内缩来自 docs/reference/plugin-row.json；容器那一行是把这份演示的 4 倍图量回去）
zh.block2Note1: 第三个是官方的界面语义图标（16 族，单色、走
zh.block2Note2: ）：同一个量法下它的墨迹几乎顶满自己的画布——两层图标的差别不在颜色，在「谁负责留白」。应用图标的留白是产品给的 7px
zh.block2Note3: 图标文件自己的内缩；语义图标的留白只有容器给的 16×16。
zh.block3Title: 3 · 浅色与深色是两版图形，不是同一个文件换个底
zh.block3Lead: 同一套图形出两版：底板换色，个别色块也单独调过（例如右下的方块在浅色版是 #5B9BF5、深色版是 #7CB7FF）
zh.block3Note1: 产品自己也是这么做的：前端图标随系统深浅色切换（
zh.block3Note3: ，两个文件、媒体查询选一个），而不是让同一个文件去猜底色。

en.title: App icon measuring board · DSH Design Resources
en.legend: Container (grey frame) · file canvas 36×36 (dashed) · ink and circumscribed circle (measured live)
en.block1Title: 1 · One row in the plugin list (measured geometry)
en.block1Lead: Row 976 × 66 · radius 20 · padding 8 · inner gap 14 · icon container 50 × 50 radius 16 (1px stroke) · artwork 36 × 36
en.harmonizerDesc: Aligns the width of the left sidebar and the content column, and brings every settings page header onto the official set
en.block2Title: 2 · Circumscribed circle and inner inset (4×, numbers measured live)
en.block2Lead1: Both icon files declare 36 × 36, but the shape itself takes up only part of the canvas — the "ink" is computed by the browser from the real paths with
en.block2Lead2: (the row geometry and the 7px inset come from docs/reference/plugin-row.json; the container row is this demo's 4× drawing measured back down)
en.block2Note1: The third is the official interface semantic icon (16 family, single colour, driven by
en.block2Note2: ): under the same measurement its ink nearly fills its own canvas — what separates the two icon layers is not colour but who supplies the whitespace. An app icon's whitespace is the 7px the product gives it
en.block2Note3: the icon file's own inset; a semantic icon's whitespace is only the 16×16 its container gives it.
en.block3Title: 3 · Light and dark are two versions of the artwork, not one file on a different ground
en.block3Lead: One set of shapes ships in two versions: the ground changes colour, and a few individual blocks are tuned on their own (the bottom-right square is #5B9BF5 in the light version and #7CB7FF in the dark one)
en.block3Note1: The product does the same for its own front-end icons, which follow the system light/dark setting (
en.block3Note3: , two files with a media query choosing between them), rather than making one file guess the ground colour.
